title: Settled observation reports are never removed, so a session row grows with every traced turn
outcome: A settled execution observation report stops occupying a session's persisted row, or the retained reports are bounded, so a long-lived session's row doesn't grow with each traced turn. A test pins it.
acceptance: Reports Engram answered definitively on every envelope (Recorded or Refused) are bounded in EngramSessionState.unadmitted_reports, while a report with a pending or locally failed envelope keeps its exact bytes; retention of locally failed reports belongs to w-19ece3f27021.
A test shows a session's report count or row size stays bounded across many traced turns whose reports settle, and that a pending report survives compaction.

Anything that reads settled reports for its own purpose (engram_named_root_binding.rs:818, the idempotency check at engram_unadmitted_worker.rs:410, engram_unadmitted_lifecycle.rs:276, engram_source_observation_removal.rs:29-37) still behaves correctly, including not re-reporting a turn whose report was compacted.

completion.summary: A session keeps only its newest 8 reports that Engram answered definitively, so a long-lived session's row stops growing with each traced turn; pending and locally failed reports keep their bytes. On master d47518ba, gated by test-bade87f1. Locally failed reports are w-19ece3f27021.
